content.title: About
content.content: Gatorade G is an electrolyte sports drink designed to replenish fluids and minerals lost during intense exercise. It contains sodium, potassium, magnesium, and carbohydrates that help maintain energy and speed up recovery.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Gatorade was created in 1965 by researchers at the University of Southern California for the US football team.
The brand offers more than 30 flavors, and G is one of the most popular thanks to its light fruity taste.
The drink contains 6% carbohydrates, providing a quick energy boost without a sharp sugar spike.
It includes electrolytes that help prevent muscle cramps.
Gatorade G is frequently used in professional sports, including the Olympic Games.

items.title: Restores electrolyte balance
items.content: Sodium and potassium replace losses from sweat, supporting muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Supports energy levels
items.content: Carbohydrates are rapidly absorbed, providing an immediate fuel source for working muscles.

items.title: Reduces risk of dehydration
items.content: The water and electrolyte content helps re‑hydrate more quickly after intense activity.

items.title: Lessens muscle cramps
items.content: Magnesium and potassium promote normal muscle contraction and help prevent spasms.

items.title: Improves post‑workout recovery
items.content: The combination of carbs and electrolytes speeds glycogen replenishment and tissue repair.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: The drink contains simple sugars, which may be undesirable for people with diabetes or those trying to lose weight.

items.title: Excess sodium
items.content: Individuals with hypertension should monitor intake, as the drink provides a notable amount of sodium.

items.title: Allergy to additives
items.content: Flavorings and colorants may cause allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Not a meal replacement
items.content: Gatorade is intended only for hydration and electrolyte restoration, not as a primary source of nutrients.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Consume Gatorade G before, during, and after exercise, 200–500 ml at a time. For prolonged activities, alternate with water to avoid excessive sugar intake.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the bottle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, it should be consumed within 3–5 days and kept refrigerated.
